newsitem.title: HUNGARY: C.Euro CESI advances on Hungarian, Polish gains.
newsitem.headline: C.Euro CESI advances on Hungarian, Polish gains.

text.p: The CESI Central European Share Index advanced on Friday to close at 1,490.73 points, up 3.58 points or 0.24 percent, the Budapest Stock Stock Exchange said.
The index advanced as prices were mostly stronger in Warsaw and Budapest.
The index, which has been published since February 1, reflects trends of 50 shares on the Budapest, Prague and Warsaw bourses.
